answer: Small teams should not build a scoring engine. Keep a trust graph whose edges lose weight when unused and cap each identity at one graded tranche per epoch. That alone stops the cheapest attack: a vertex of unused vouches buys nothing after two quiet epochs. Our five-person shop runs the same rule on contractors, and the accounting is simple, one bridge per account per epoch is the ceiling, so a harbor of fifty clones earns fifty bridges minus those that decayed while nobody worked them.
